title: Discotek to Release Digimon Frontier, Pani Poni Dash!, Lupin III: Part II, Outlanders, Samurai Pizza Cats, 10+ More Anime on BD This Year
content: Discotek Media announced at its panel on Saturday at Otakon that it will release the following anime on home video: The "hard action" net anime centers on Inspector Zenigata, Lupin's nemesis and erstwhile ally, as the protagonist.
author: ANN

title: Dandadan Creator Celebrates Crunchyroll’s New Shonen Jump Debut With New Look
content: The Summer 2026 anime season has already released all of the latest shows, including one of the hottest Shonen Jump series in recent years. Black Torch made its debut on Crunchyroll this season, and it piqued the viewers’ interest with its exceptional animation.
author: ComicBook

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Becomes a Massive Hit on Netflix With Over a Million Views After Latest Update
content: Jujutsu Kaisen Season 4 will take a while before dropping new updates, but the anime already has several surprises planned for fans this year. Season 3 of the anime featured the aftermath of the brutal Shibuya Incident Arc before moving on to the Culling Game.
author: ComicBook

title: Cancelled Shonen Jump Creators to Return for New Releases This August
content: The creators behind some cancelled and ended Shonen Jump series are coming back with some new one-shot releases later this month. Shueisha’s various Jump magazines have been having a much better year than last year overall.
author: ComicBook

title: Bungo Stray Dogs Shuts Down Major Project While Fans Wait on Season 6
content: Bungo Stray Dogs is one of the biggest anime franchises now going today, but unfortunately it has shut down a major project while fans are waiting on the next major season of the series.
author: ComicBook

title: The Promised Neverland Returns With New Look Ahead of Summer Revival
content: The Promised Neverland is readying for a major comeback to help commemorate the 10th anniversary of its original debut with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine, and the creators behind it all have dropped a cool new look ahead of its revival.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll Confirms New Fall 2026 Anime & Beyond With Shangri-La Frontier Season 3, More
content: Crunchyroll has confirmed a new wave of anime releases coming to the streaming platform later this year and in 2027, and they include big licenses for Shangri-La Frontier Season 3 and more.
author: ComicBook

title: Futurama Drops First Look at Major Crossover With Cancelled Netflix Show Reunion
content: Futurama is making its big return to Hulu later this week, and to celebrate has dropped the first look at its highly anticipated crossover with long cancelled Netflix animated series.
author: ComicBook

title: Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia Anime's New Video Unveils Cast Member Kujira
content: The staff for Jaadugar: A Witch in Mongolia , the television anime of Tomato Soup 's A Witch's Life in Mongol ( Tenmaku no Jādūgar ) manga, announced with its third promotional video on Sunday that Kujira will play Boraqchin, Ögedei's first wife and Empress.
author: ANN

title: Black Clover Highlights Asta With First Look at Final Manga Release
content: Black Clover is gearing up to return to shelves in Japan with its final manga release ever, and the first look at the manga finale is showing off a cool new look at Asta to help say goodbye.
author: ComicBook
